output.population: Parkinson's disease patients in a double-blind randomized trial; twenty-five patients assigned to Neuroepo (n=15) or placebo (n=10), this record covering the placebo group.
output.summary: Raw resting-state EEG in BIDS format from the placebo arm of a double-blind randomized trial of Neuroepo in Parkinson's disease, recorded before and six months after drug administration.
